decisions.reason: Although the firm has maritime customers and strong in-house R&D, submarine interior lighting is relatively distant from its core offer and was marketed less prominently, so the firm is less able to interpret early feedback and more likely to reallocate resources.

A medical examination light builds on the firm's lighting know-how and professional customer base, and its own R&D should let management learn from initial results and refine the product rather than withdraw it.

Industrial explosion-proof luminaires fit the firm's established industrial lighting capabilities very well, and the broader product line plus in-house R&D make continued development and retention highly likely.
The designer task light is close to the existing offer and even a relaunch of a previously popular product, so the firm has strong related knowledge and little reason to remove it quickly.
